summary: What counts as exploration is now strict: a paper that was never shown and matches no concept of the learning map (neither an understood concept nor a still locked one). The reader's own wording: path papers they have not answered can be pushed again and again, so a paper of a concept they can read now stays a candidate until they save, turn down, mark too hard or understood it, the least shown first. The 'off path' label and filler from the previous change are removed; a batch that is short says why, and an ordinary batch is used only when there is neither a path paper nor an exploration candidate. Previously a paper of an already understood concept (3D Gaussian Splatting) was the first exploration pick because it resembled the reader's interests most.
scope_note: Directly on main, after the merge c83ab62.

budget_impact.rationale: Local ranking and selection only; no model call, no network, no stored data change.
budget_impact.before: exploration = any unseen paper outside the readable concepts, by similarity; path papers shown once
budget_impact.after: exploration = never shown and matching no concept; unanswered path papers repeat
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: 0 of 1047 strings missing an English entry

open_risks: The pool of papers matching no concept of the map can be empty or small; then a batch has no exploration slot.
A path paper the reader never answers keeps coming back; the reader's only ways to stop it are to answer it or to mark the concept known.
The Tauri window was not clicked through; the owner's real library was not read.
